title: Reading, Writing and Repairing Game-Theoretic Policies in Weight Space
abstract: arXiv:2611.31979v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Can a language model work in the weight space of a policy network for a repeated game? We put four questions to a mid-size open model, on recurrent networks of 1{,}218 weights with exactly checkable answers. Given a population of opponents described in English, write a policy that is optimal: its value is a finite computation over the agent's information state, so a submitted network has an exact gap from the optimum. Given a network's weights, report its action after each of fifteen opponent histories; recover the state machine it implements, judged on every opponent sequence to depth ten; or repair a network whose output was altered in one place and say which round first goes wrong. The model recovers the program in 62 of 66 replies, reports all fifteen behavioral entries correctly in 34 of 36, and attains the optimum in 20 of 20 when it states a policy the evaluator compiles. translated_title: 在权重空间中读取、写入与修复博弈论策略
translated_abstract: 语言模型能否在重复博弈策略网络的权重空间中工作？我们向一个中等规模的开源模型提出四个问题，研究对象是具有1218个权重、答案可被精确验证的循环网络。给定一个用英文描述的对手群体，写出一个最优策略：策略的价值是对智能体信息状态的有限计算，因此所提交的网络与最优值之间存在可精确度量的差距。给定一个网络的权重，报告它在十五个对手历史序列中每个历史之后的动作；恢复它所实现的状态机（以深度为十的所有对手序列评判）；或者修复一个输出在某一处被篡改的网络，并指出从哪一轮开始首次出错。该模型在66个回复中的62个成功恢复了程序，在36次中有34次正确报告了全部十五个行为条目，并且当它给出的策略可被评估器编译时，在20次中全部20次达到最优。修复是例外情况：18个中仅4个被成功修复，18个中5个诊断出故障（原摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文构建了一组在权重空间中答案可被精确验证的博弈策略读写任务，证明中等规模开源语言模型能够在1218个权重的循环网络中恢复策略程序、报告其行为并写出最优策略，但修复被篡改网络的能力明显较弱。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces exactly verifiable weight-space tasks for game-theoretic policy networks, showing that a mid-size open language model can read, write, and recover optimal repeated-game policies encoded in 1,218-weight recurrent networks, though repairing altered networks remains a notable weakness.
